responsibility: Implements the overall Rust HIR type-resolution driver and a portion of trait-item typing support. TypeResolution::Resolve runs crate-wide item resolution, executes the inherent-impl overlap check, and finalizes remaining inference variables by defaulting and unifying them; this file also provides core TraitItemReference routines for computing associated function, const, and type TyTy representations from HIR trait items, including synthetic self parameters for trait methods.
same_name_distinction: Provides executable type-checking logic for this stem: the crate-level TypeResolution::Resolve pass and TraitItemReference type construction routines live here, while the .h file mainly defines the shared TypeCheckContext data structures and public entry points they use.
